title: Malicious code in orderbook-volt-plugin (npm)
description: The orderbook-volt-plugin npm package versions 0.0.0-stage, 0.0.1, and 0.0.2 contain malicious code. Any computer with this package installed or running should be considered fully compromised. Secrets and keys stored on the affected system must be rotated immediately from a different, clean machine. Removing the package alone does not guarantee removal of all malicious software introduced by it.
